checks.method_or_action: + Add Project, fill fields, Save project (POST /api/projects)
checks.expected_behavior: Project saved as a private draft; creator is maintainer

checks.method_or_action: Paste public repo URL, Import details (GET /api/github/repo?url=...)
checks.setup: Any public GitHub repository, e.g. the team's QA repository listed in RELEASE_NOTES_R3.md
checks.expected_behavior: Title, description, languages, date and repo link proposed as editable values; nothing saved until Save project

checks.method_or_action: Clear or change Repository links, Save project (PUT /api/projects/{project_id})
checks.setup: Existing project with one or more repository links
checks.expected_behavior: Project record, ID and public URL remain; zero, one or many repository links allowed

checks.method_or_action: Add teammate by GitHub username and standard role (POST /api/projects/{project_id}/invitations); invitee Accept/Decline (POST /api/projects/{project_id}/respond)
checks.setup: Reviewer B has signed in and verified once
checks.expected_behavior: Invitee not on public page until accepted; accepted contributor shown with standard role
Only the signed-in contributor's own row changes; hiding removes it from their profile but keeps the relationship and project
Soft delete: hidden from public page, kept in database, restorable with original role and statement

checks.setup: At least one other accepted contributor
checks.expected_behavior: New maintainer edits shared fields; old maintainer cannot; same project ID and URL

checks.method_or_action: Create project with a repository URL already used (POST /api/projects returns 409 duplicate_repository; POST /api/projects/duplicates)
checks.setup: An existing project with that repository URL
checks.expected_behavior: Warning with View project and Ask to join (POST /api/projects/{project_id}/join); similar titles warned, never merged

checks.method_or_action: Open in two sessions as maintainer; save A then save B without reload (PUT /api/projects/{project_id} with version)
checks.setup: Shared fields are editable by the maintainer only (team decision)
checks.expected_behavior: Second save refused with 409 stale_version; conflict box keeps B's unsaved text; A's change preserved

checks.setup: Demo project from RELEASE_NOTES_R3.md; for broken case set Playable demo link to a dead https URL
checks.expected_behavior: Play Demo / Watch Video / View Source links, fallback image and caption, contributor roles; broken demo or image leaves page and navigation usable; usable at 390px

checks.method_or_action: Submit javascript: or <script> as a demo/fallback link
checks.expected_behavior: 422: links must be https URLs; text fields always rendered as plain text

checks.method_or_action: PUT with another project's ID using own bearer token (browser devtools)
checks.role: verified student who is not the maintainer
checks.setup: Any project ID visible in a public project URL
checks.expected_behavior: 403: only the project maintainer can change shared project details

checks.method_or_action: Filter by a project technology a contributor does not list as a skill (GET /api/directory?skills=...)
checks.setup: Project with technologies Unity, C#, Blender and contributors with different personal skills
checks.expected_behavior: Contributor not matched by project technologies; R1/R2 directory, privacy, publication, customization and inquiry unchanged
projects lists accepted, featured, published projects with title and role; private fields still withheld
